# [TASK] Remove ServiceMonitors for services not deployed to Kubernetes

## Task
`infrastructure/kubernetes/monitoring/service-monitors/` holds eight
ServiceMonitors, but the Kubernetes base deploys only five of those services.
config-service, discovery-service and media-service are not deployed there —
the first two on purpose (ADR-005), media-service simply is not in the base.

Those three select no pods and scrape nothing. They also suggest to a reader
that these services run in Kubernetes.

## Parent Story
Parent: #239

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The three dead ServiceMonitors are removed, or kept with a comment stating plainly that the service is not deployed to Kubernetes and why
- [x] The monitoring README reflects whichever choice is made
- [x] The alert rules no longer name services that cannot report

## Estimate
**Hours:** 1

## Notes
Verified: commit `b4d0a29` deleted the config-service and discovery-service ServiceMonitors and updated the alerts and README.
